messages.body_plain:
Hi Dylan,

On Wed, Aug 01, 2018 at 08:29:55PM +0200, Dylan Aïssi wrote:
> Could someone upload them? Thanks.

Thanks for your work on these packages.

When locking at d/copyright I see:

Files: *
       src/DataRcpp.h
       src/DataSparse.*
       src/rangerCpp.cpp
       src/utilityRcpp.cpp
Copyright: 2014-2018 Marvin N. Wright, Stefan Wager, Philipp Probst
License: GPL-3+

which uselessly adds some specific files which are included anyway in *.

The next paragraph overrides those files since a latter detailed
specification overrides what formerly was specified more generally.

So you rather should mention all those files in src/* that are covered
by Expat license.  I have not build the package but I'd be astonished if
lintian would not have told you something in these lines - if not that
might be worth a lintian bug report.

I've just uploaded r-cran-reticulate to new.

Kind regards from DebConf

     Andreas.

-- 
http://fam-tille.de

messages.subject: 500 Can't connect to cran.r-project.org:443 (certificate verify failed)
messages.subject_clean: 500 Can't connect to cran.r-project.org:443 (certificate verify failed)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

early this morning I was able to fetch new upstream versions but now this fails:

salsa/r-pkg-team/r-cran-pkgconfig(master) $ uscan --verbose
uscan info: uscan (version 2.18.3) See uscan(1) for help
uscan info: Scan watch files in .
uscan info: Check debian/watch and debian/changelog in .
uscan info: package="r-cran-pkgconfig" version="2.0.1-4" (as seen in debian/changelog)
uscan info: package="r-cran-pkgconfig" version="2.0.1" (no epoch/revision)
uscan info: Check debian/watch and debian/changelog in ./.git/logs/refs/remotes/origin
uscan info: Check debian/watch and debian/changelog in ./.git/logs/refs/heads
uscan info: Check debian/watch and debian/changelog in ./.git/refs/tags
uscan info: Check debian/watch and debian/changelog in ./.git/refs/remotes/origin
uscan info: Check debian/watch and debian/changelog in ./.git/refs/heads
uscan info: ./debian/changelog sets package="r-cran-pkgconfig" version="2.0.1"
uscan info: Process watch file at: debian/watch
    package = r-cran-pkgconfig
    version = 2.0.1
    pkg_dir = .
uscan info: Last orig.tar.* tarball version (from debian/changelog): 2.0.1
uscan info: Last orig.tar.* tarball version (dversionmangled): 2.0.1
uscan info: Requesting URL:
   https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/
uscan warn: In watchfile debian/watch, reading webpage
  https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/ failed: 500 Can't connect to cran.r-project.org:443 (certificate verify failed)
uscan info: Scan finished

So something broke with the certificate of r-project.org in the last
couple of hours.

Kind regards

       Andreas.

-- 
http://fam-tille.de

messages.body_plain:
On Fri, Aug 17, 2018 at 3:19 PM, Andreas Tille <andreas at an3as.eu> wrote:
> This seems to have settled now ...

The CRAN root server is often overloaded. It might be better to use
the cloudfront mirror, which gets synched every hour and is never down:
https://cloud.r-project.org/
